newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht rallies offshore, widening two-tier spre.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht rallies offshore, widening two-tier spre.

text.p: The Thai baht surged against the dollar to a new 13-year high in offshore markets following a central bank statement that it would retain a wide two-tier spread for the baht in offshore and domestic markets, dealers said.
At 0807 GMT, the baht rallied to 23.700/23.800 to the dollar in offshore markets from 24.000/24.100 in the early morning. The baht held mainly steady at 25.675/25.695 in the domestic market.
"Initially, they expect offshore and domestic spot rates to narrow, so they started giving up the swaps and buying dollar," said a Singapore-based dealer.
